data.name: Fur and Fury: Bunny Seeks Revenge
data.detailed_description:
Set in Pixel-City, 1996, where video games are shot in studios by living and breathing sprite actors. The game follows Bunny Rosenberg, a rising game star whose life shatters after a brutal tragedy. Her grief soon turns to fury as she hunts for the truth - and vengeance. What begins as a personal vendetta pulls Bunny into a web of lies, betrayal, and corruption - unraveling a conspiracy that threatens the future of all sprites.

Armed with nothing but her wits, her rage, and an unbreakable will, Bunny sets out to track down those who took everything from her - and to take it back in blood. She may be a four-foot bunny, but what she lacks in size, she makes up for in fury.

Bunny is too small to fight - use your wits to claim revenge. Solve puzzles, investigate a killing, uncover the truth behind the disappearance of sprites, and unravel a murderous conspiracy in this story-driven thriller. 

Key Features

  • A unique fusion of point & click adventure, puzzle platforming, and stealth gameplay.

  • A gripping narrative set in an alternate 1990s, where video games are filmed by sprite actors in the gaming industry capital of Pixel-City.

  • A love letter to retro games, told through a modern lens.

  • Hand-crafted pixel art and animation that brings sprites and their city to life.

  • Created with passion by a solo developer.

  • More to come - stay tuned!
